## Outcome

What capability does this change add, strengthen or make easier to use?

## Why it matters

Explain the builder, provider, operator or institution outcome. Lead with the resulting product value rather than the internal development history.

## Product and contract impact

Describe any public API, persistence, migration, security, provider, FX, settlement or compatibility impact.

## Proof

List the verification, tests and manual product checks that prove the change.

## Public surface

Note any README, documentation, screenshot, product page, changelog or release-story updates needed so the public repository reflects the capability accurately.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated files.
- [ ] Public contracts and documentation were updated where necessary.
- [ ] Financial and security failure paths remain covered where relevant.
- [ ] Public copy is confident, technically precise and outcome-led.
- [ ] No unsupported partnership, audit, certification, customer or live-provider claims were introduced.
- [ ] No credentials, customer data, internal conversations or tool logs are included.
